title: Thank you
lyrics_original: Thank you for the price you paid
Thank you for this life you gave
There is no one like you
There is no one like you God

bible_verses.telugu: మీరు విశ్వాసముద్వారా కృపచేతనే రక్షింపబడియున్నారు; ఇది మీవలన కలిగినది కాదు, దేవుని వరమే. అది క్రియలవలన కలిగినదికాదు గనుక ఎవడును అతిశయపడ వీలులేదు.
bible_verses.english: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—not by works, so that no one can boast.

bible_verses.telugu: మన ప్రభువగు యేసుక్రీస్తు తండ్రియైన దేవుడు స్తుతింపబడునుగాక.
bible_verses.english: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead.

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే దేవుడు మనయెడల తన ప్రేమను వెల్లడిపరచుచున్నాడు; ఎట్లనగా మనమింకను పాపులమై యుండగానే క్రీస్తు మనకొరకు చనిపోయెను.
bible_verses.english: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

devotional.prayer_english: Father, thank You for Your overwhelming kindness and the priceless gift of salvation through Jesus. I am so grateful for the cross and the unending grace that covers my life every single day. Help me to live with a posture of thanksgiving, constantly anchored in the living hope You have provided. There truly is no one like You, my God and Redeemer. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we pause to consider the cross, our hearts naturally overflow with gratitude for a love we could never earn. Jesus met us in our deepest need, offering unending grace, mercy, and a living hope that anchors our souls. Taking a moment to simply say "thank you" shifts our focus from our daily worries to the unmatched goodness of our Creator. As you sing today, let your praise be a tender response to the unbelievable price He paid to give you eternal life.
